Title: Public preview: Azure subscription cost reporting and analysis for enterprise customers

Body.Content: Azure Enterprise Agreement (EA) users can view and analyze their subscription costs across different pivots in the Azure portal. This preview addresses a top request from our EA customers to empower subscription admins with visibility into their costs. To learn more, read the blog post.
